note_tweet.text:
I am writing this to address recent inquiries from some mutual friends regarding my relationship with "Kumohato."

To be clear: we have mutually unfollowed and blocked each other on Chinese social media platforms. There is absolutely no personal contact between us at this time.

The only remaining connection is a technical and historical issue concerning the transfer of Twitter/X monetization revenue. This is because he registered using my identity information when he met the threshold as a minor.
While he has submitted a new tax form, Stripe regulations prevent changing the linked identity/bank account once monetization is set up, even after he has become an adult.

I have repeatedly suggested he simply close the account and restart—given his influence, this would not be difficult. However, he refuses, claiming that deleting the account would "erase all evidence of the harm done to him." I will offer no further comment on his personal reasons.

As my workload increases with my personal research projects and career, I will not have the time to oversee these finances, which could lead to unnecessary complications.
I sincerely hope this technical issue can be resolved promptly and amicably.

Thank you for your understanding.
